# Vendored browser libraries

These pinned browser distributions keep the Tailnet webapp self-contained and usable without a public CDN or frontend build step.

| Library | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| marked | 18.0.7 | MIT | https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.0.7 |
| DOMPurify | 3.4.12 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/dompurify/v/3.4.12 |
| KaTeX | 0.18.1 | MIT | https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex/v/0.18.1 |

Only the browser bundles, KaTeX CSS, and WOFF2 fonts are copied from the npm tarballs. Full license texts are in `licenses/`.
